rationale: This is a general platform agreement rather than a digital-goods storefront, so it doesn't market 'buying' content while hiding a licence-only reality; it plainly grants users a revocable licence to the Services and is largely upfront about that. It is aggressive elsewhere: a perpetual, irrevocable, sublicensable claim over user content, unilateral termination/suspension 'for any or no reason,' a $100 liability cap, and broad indemnification, though there is no arbitration or class-action waiver.
evidence_quotes: Reddit grants you a personal, non-transferable, non-exclusive, revocable, limited license to use and access the Services
worldwide, royalty-free, perpetual, irrevocable, non-exclusive, transferable, and sublicensable license to use, copy, modify... Your Content
We may suspend or terminate your Account... at any time for any or no reason
